div.head: Abt 54.5
div.ab: Gif man þone lytlan finger ofaslæhð, XI scill' gebete.
Gif man þone lytlan finger ofaslæhð, XI scill' gebete.
Gif man þone lytlan finger of aslæhð, XI sciƚƚ gebete.
Wenn jemand den kleinen Finger abhaut, büsse er 11 Schill.
If someone cuts off the little finger, let him pay 11 shillings.
If a man strikes off a little finger, he shall pay 11 shillings compensation.
If a person strikes off the little finger, let him pay [with] 11 shillings.

note.seg: Ebd. 3c. Nur durch Zahlenfehler verführt wollten hier Wilda und Steenstrup (Danelag 307) emendieren. Der kleine Finger gilt höher als der 3. und 4. bei Baiern und Alamannen, höher als der 2., 3., 4. in Lex Sax. 13

Ibid. 3c. Wilda and Steenstrup (Danelag 307) wanted to emend here only because they were misled by an error in the figures. Among the Bavarians and Alamanni the little finger is valued higher than the 3rd and 4th, and in Lex Sax. 13 higher than the 2nd, 3rd and 4th

note.label: þone
note.seg: The demonstrative here serves to close the section enumerating damage to the fingers.

note.label: lytlan
note.seg: i made into y by scribe.
